product.title: Wagvive Self-Cleaning Slicker Brush
product.body_html:
Effortless deshedding, one click to clean.

Removes loose fur and gentle tangles without tugging on skin, then releases the collected coat with a single button press — no pulling fur off the brush by hand. Designed for regular use on dogs and cats with any coat length, and especially helpful for senior pets who need slower, gentler grooming.

  • Self-cleaning retractable bristles
  • Gentle on sensitive, aging skin
  • Reduces loose hair around the home
  • Comfortable, non-slip grip
